items.stemEn: The kids ____ a box of old toys in the garden.
items.stemZh: 孩子們把一盒舊玩具埋在花園裡。

items.stemEn: He showed us a card ____, and everyone was surprised.
items.stemZh: 他表演了一個撲克牌魔術，大家都很驚訝。

items.passageEn: At my cousin's birthday party, a man did magic tricks. First, he adjusted his big hat. Then he pretended to cut a string into two pieces, but it was still one piece! Next, he buried a ring in a bowl of rice. When we looked, the ring was gone. Then he found it in a child's pocket! Everyone shouted and laughed.
items.passageZh: 在我表親的生日派對上，有個男人表演魔術。他先調整了一下他的大帽子。接著他假裝把一條繩子剪成兩段，結果繩子還是完整的一條！然後他把一枚戒指埋進一碗米裡。我們一看，戒指不見了。最後他竟然從一個小朋友的口袋裡把戒指找了出來！大家又叫又笑。

questions.questionZh: 他表演的第一個魔術是什麼？

The children are playing with floats in the pool.
rubricZh: 正在進行的動作可寫例如 are playing

referenceEn: He pretended not to understand me.
He pretended that he didn't understand me.
rubricZh: 用 pretend 表示「假裝」（例如 pretended not to understand、pretended that… 等）
過去的事用過去式；寫現在式 pretends 也正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：例句 Is this a trick question?（陷阱題）中 trick 作名詞修飾語，意思偏「刁難、陷阱」，與釋義「把戲；戲法；花招」對不太上；且干擾項「簡單的／長的／重要的」是形容詞，與釋義詞性不一致。建議改用 a magic trick 類例句。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義維持「把戲；戲法；花招」，改例句為 My dog can do a new trick.（和 mcq 撲克牌魔術、閱讀魔術表演情境都不同），干擾項改名詞「玩具／食物／名字」
